prompt: Create an original 180 second acoustic swing jazz instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: acoustic guitar, violin, upright bass. Style: crisp rhythmic guitar and playful violin phrases. Tempo approximately 134 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A gentle and melancholic acoustic piece featuring a prominent acoustic guitar melody supported by warm, expressive strings (violin, cello). The arrangement is delicate and evokes a nostalgic or reflective mood.
description.zh: 一首温柔而忧郁的器乐曲，以突出的原声吉他旋律为主，并由温暖而富有表现力的弦乐（小提琴、大提琴）伴奏。编曲精致，营造出怀旧或沉思的氛围。
